Sandbox_JumpscareBanEconomy_Enabled_tool: Master switch for the whole mod, off by default. While off, the "Buy Jumpscare Gags" button is hidden from the economy balance window and the server refuses every gag purchase.
Sandbox_JumpscareBanEconomy_FartPrice_to: How many Scraps a player pays to play a global Fart for everyone on the server.
Sandbox_JumpscareBanEconomy_CryPrice_too: How many Scraps a player pays to play a global Cry for everyone on the server.
Sandbox_JumpscareBanEconomy_KachowPrice_: How many Scraps a player pays to play a global Kachow for everyone on the server.
